{{Quote|Lumps...don't come here without them.|A Meatlump vendor|<ref name="SWG:MTP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|"Meatlumps Theme Park" on Corellia}}</ref>}}
[[File:MeatlumpLump.png|150px|thumb|Meatlump Lump]]

The '''Meatlump Lump''' was the official currency used by the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

==Form==
{{Quote|That won't do. This should have me on it. Much better.|The [[Meatlump King]] recognizes an unmarked lump|<ref name="SWG:MTP" />}}
[[File:UnmarkedMeatlumpLump.jpg|150px|thumb|The Meatlump King would on occasion paint himself on unmarked lumps.]]
The Meatlump Lump was nothing more than a lump of painted rock. On the Lump was the face of the [[Meatlump King]], the symbol of the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit]], and [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] text which read, "In Meatlump We Trust." The Meatlump King would on occasion mint Meatlump Lumps himself, by painting his own face on unmarked lumps. Meatlump Lumps were accepted by Meatlump vendors based in the [[Meatlump Hideout]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meatlump Lumps were a type of currency in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Meatlump Lumps were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref> Players could acquire them by doing certain tasks for the Meatlumps. Players could then use the Lumps to purchase a variety of goods from the Meatlumps.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

The text, which reads, "In Meatlump We Trust," shares similarity to the United States currency which reads, "In God We Trust."
